plan.optimizer: Adam, moments restored from the beta-1 checkpoint

r6.noise: beta-1 R6 III model (NoiseModel of the parent campaign)

d60.photon_covariance: none (white shot noise): not measured on the 60D
d60.clip: white level of each dark frame minus its black

bursts.crops: centre and lower right, 512 per plane
bursts.reference: mean of the other frames, row-matched to the frame, own noise removed by the qualified law

plateau.rule: stop when both metrics gained less than gain_db between the best of the earlier controls and the best of the last window

limits: ISO 100 60D frames are clean proxies with their own residual noise, not truth
60D photon noise simulated white (no neighbour covariance measured), Poisson at the qualified slope
Real bursts are the bracket series of 13 November under 100 Hz light; row matching removes most of the flicker, not all
The bursts are the only real 60D noise: they are never used for training
